headline: Private consumption shows slight gain in September, INEGI estimates
summary: Private consumption rose 0.1% in September after growing 0.5% in August, according to Inegi's timely consumption indicator. The same trend is estimated for October.
why: Private consumption is the largest component of Mexico's GDP, so changes in household spending shape the country's economic outlook.
original_headline: Consumo privado tiene leve avance en septiembre, estima el Inegi
